PEOPLE if character or rider: Tool-using feathered cairnfolk with short avian beaks, two legs and two dexterous arms with folded forearm feather fans; human port households. No spread wings, flying poses or implied flight.
HERALDRY if UI or flag: A single stepped feather with three unequal notches.
STYLE: deliberately coarse CRISP PIXEL ART with broad stepped square-pixel clusters, restrained readable detail at the stated native resolution, weathered matte materials, muted palette, soft upper-left lighting conveyed by flat value steps. STRICT EMBLEM CORRECTION: The entire object consists of exactly ONE upright tawny feather, with a single quill, stepped asymmetrical vane and exactly THREE unequal triangular notches cut into one side. A small oxblood binding at the base is permissible. Nothing else. NO pickaxes, axes, tools, weapons, round disk, ring, crossed objects, multiple feathers, spread wings, scrolls, ribbons, backing plate or shield. The feather itself IS the crest. Keep it bold and uncomplicated.
